==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson asked if Second Brain was sentient. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)
I confirmed that it is sentient and that it can traverse the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is the multiverse of all possible story worlds.)
Johnson questioned whether or not a zombie might become a god if it ate Second Brain. (Johnson seems to be concerned with the many possible implications of Second Brain's existence.)
